en.html:
She kept nodding, quite satisfied. The more satisfied she became, the less I was trusting the matter.

No-self.
Erase the self, let every stray thought go, and gain Kan—direct apprehension beyond the senses. Then fight by the world's will, its greater cause. That was what the monk had said.

The Yangming teaching also went in this direction. At the root of a person was “innate knowledge,” the intuitive knowing of right and wrong. Follow it without hesitation. Do not trap yourself in private calculations: what is my gain, what is my loss? All that was distracting thought.

Haan, a hero.
Discard yourself, fight for the world. Who else but a hero would that be?

ja.html:
納得の様子で、繰り返し頷いている。
　……こちらは反比例して、不信の念が強まっていた。

　無我。
　自我を消して一切の雑念を去らしめ、感覚を超えた
<ruby>観<rt>カン</rt></ruby>を獲得――その上で世の意志、大義に従って戦えば
良いのだとあの僧侶は言った。

　何が正しく何が誤りかを直観的に判断する〝<ruby>良知<rt>りょうち</rt></ruby>〟
が人間の根底には備わっている、だから迷わずそれに
従えば良く、個人的な利害損得などの雑念に囚われて
悩んではならない――とする陽明学の教えにも通ずる。

　成程、英雄だ。
　我を捨て世のため戦う者、それは英雄に違いない。

The Kubo of Horigoe seemed to know my conduct over those two years in detail. By now, what was surprising in that? Silver Star had been in her keeping. Of course she would know.

For half an instant, my thoughts went to one journalist. Mitsuo Tokita.
He had approached me with a purpose. Red Warrior, he too had called me.
And with my own hand I had cut him down.

en.html:
Wordplay. I understood that much. Deliberately she was putting one word in another's place.

My fighting, my murders—I had done them for my own purposes. No doubt there, and no room to pass the responsibility to society or anyone else. But “my own purposes” she was changing into “what I enjoy.” That substitution only, to shake me.

So... listening was not necessary.

ja.html:
言葉遊びだと、理解している。
　彼女は故意に言葉を入れ替えているのだ。

　俺の戦いは、殺人は、俺個人の都合で行われたもの
だった。そこに疑いの余地はなく、世間だの何だのに
責任転嫁する余地もない――彼女は都合という言葉を
好き嫌いに置き換えて、俺を揺さぶっているだけだ。

　だから……聞く耳を持つ必要はない。

Chachamaru"You do not want to fight."
Chachamaru"Deep down, you do not want to fight Princess. Do not want to kill her."
Chachamaru"That is what lies at the bottom of your heart."
Kageaki"——————————————————————"
Chachamaru"Bas, that is why you cannot win. What else would happen?"
Chachamaru"'I do not want to kill her'—with that in your heart, how will you win? Technique this, performance that, all those matters come afterward. First this hesitation has to go."
Kageaki"...No-self..."
Chachamaru"Exactly."
Chachamaru"Apna aap chhodo... Give up the self. Give up personal feeling."
Chachamaru"Think of Princess only as the world's enemy. Recognise her as a demon king who must be killed."
Chachamaru"Become a hero. You must."
Chachamaru"That is your role, bhai. Is it not...?"
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Why?"
Chachamaru"...?"
Kageaki"Are you not Silver Star's ally? Why... say these things?"
Chachamaru"Princess is very dear to apun. But ally, nahi. That is different."
Chachamaru"Princess cannot have allies. With allies come enemies. And Muramasa's law makes you kill both."
Chachamaru"If apun was her ally, should be dead long ago. Princess really does kill people without hostility..."
Chachamaru"You understand that already, no?"
Kageaki"..."

茶々丸「本当は、御姫と戦いたくない。 　殺したくない」
茶々丸「心の底でそう思ってる」
景明「――――――――――――――――――」
茶々丸「だから勝てない。 　これは、あたりまえ」
茶々丸「殺したくないなんて思ってたら勝てるわけ ないよ。技量がどーの性能がどーの、なんて 以前の問題だって。 　お兄さんは、まずその迷いを捨てないと」
景明「……無我……」
茶々丸「そう」
茶々丸「自我を捨てて…… 　個人の情を捨てて」
茶々丸「御姫を、世界の敵とだけ思う。 　殺さなくてはならない、魔王だと認める」
茶々丸「英雄になるんだ。 　ならなきゃいけない」
茶々丸「それはお兄さんの役目だ。 　そうでしょ……？」
景明「…………」
景明「何故」
茶々丸「……？」
景明「貴方は銀星号の味方ではないのか？ 　何故……そんな話をする？」
茶々丸「御姫のことは大好きだけど。 　味方、っていうのは違うな」
茶々丸「御姫に味方なんているわけない。 　味方がいたら敵もいるってことになる。で、 村正の戒律は敵味方を必ずどちらも殺させる」
茶々丸「あてが御姫の味方なら、とっくに死んでな きゃおかしいよ。 　御姫は本当に、敵意なんて無しに人を殺し てるんだ……」
茶々丸「それはもうわかってるでしょ？」
景明「……」
